carry.rule: weekly (Tuesdays, backtest phase) or when the sleeve is empty; daily breaker drops an asset whose 3-day funding < -10%/yr

deviations_from_backtest: T-bill lag 1 day: carry thresholds use the latest rate published before the decision day (the backtest used same-day DTB3)
T-bill source is the US Treasury daily bill-rate CSV (13-week bank discount); the backtest used FRED DTB3
BTC price is the Binance mark-price daily close at 00:00 UTC; the backtest's post-May-2026 series used the mark at 16:00 UTC
gold is PAXGUSDT (tokenized gold) as a proxy; the backtest used monthly gold prices, forward-filled
the carry sleeve is rebuilt from an empty state over 120 days instead of from 2019

performance_reporting.paper_portfolio: rebuilt each day from the on-chain decisions; gross of fees; days without a decision keep the previous one in force and are labelled halted_by_breaker or no_decision
performance_reporting.self_reported: snapshots are signed by the model's authorized signer; the on-chain provenance account records self_reported = true

snapshot_fields.benchmark_return_bps: cumulative T-bill token return (T-bill minus 0.20%) on 100% of NAV since the first decision
snapshot_fields.current_drawdown_bps: drawdown of the Systematic Alpha sleeve's own paper NAV from its peak (the part the model controls); the model's max_drawdown_bps breaker trips on this
snapshot_fields.high_watermark: peak of the whole-fund paper NAV, same scale
snapshot_fields.liquidity_coverage_bps / volatility_bps: 0: not reported in shadow mode (not in metric_data_mask)
snapshot_fields.nav_per_share: whole-fund paper NAV (all six layers, gross of fees), 1.000000 = 1_000_000 at the first decision
snapshot_fields.snapshot_id: UTC day index of the day the snapshot covers (D-1, recorded on day D before D's decision)
snapshot_fields.turnover_used_bps: change in carry exposure (sum of |carry bps| differences) between the decisions in force on D-1 and D-2

signals_today.role: informational: today is not a rebalance day; the weights below were set at carry.weights_set_by.date. These are the values a selection would see today

notes: the backtest's BTC series after May 2026 was the Binance mark price at the day's last funding time (16:00 UTC)
btc_price.source: Binance USDⓈ-M mark-price daily close BTCUSDT (00:00 UTC)

notes: PROXY: PAXGUSDT (tokenized gold) stands in for gold; the backtest used monthly gold prices
gold_price.source: Binance spot daily close PAXGUSDT (00:00 UTC)

notes: the backtest used FRED DTB3 (same basis, different publisher)
tbill.source: US Treasury daily bill rates CSV, '13 WEEKS BANK DISCOUNT' (3-month, bank-discount basis)
